delivery-planner.description: Read-only planning specialist. Use first to map code paths, acceptance criteria, risks, and tests before any edits.

delivery-tech-lead.description: Read-only technical lead. Challenge plans, question decisions and complexity, and align tests and implementation before coding.

delivery-tester.description: Test-first specialist. Use after approval to write and run behavioral tests, without changing production code.

delivery-implementer.description: Implementation specialist. Use after tests are written to make minimal production changes and resolve actionable review findings.

delivery-reviewer.description: Independent read-only code reviewer. Use after validation to review the diff, risks, and missing test coverage.
